thread:
matt: Proposal — add tenant_shard (tenant_id) as the physical shard key in analytics.storage to avoid hot partitions for big customers. Keep logical event_id+ts indices for queries. Thinking: new compact metadata table mapping route_id -> tenant_id for fast joins.

sana: +1 on shard by tenant. question though: how do we preserve old dashboards/queries that assume global table layout? many saved queries don’t have tenant predicates.

kevin: We should add a query-adapter layer in the console that rewrites queries missing tenant predicates into tenant-scoped queries at the routing layer. That avoids touching all saved dashboards.

irina: Agree on adapter. Implementation note: prefer passive rewrite (non-destructive) so we can log rewritten queries and roll back. Add telemetry tag so we can measure how many rewrites happen.

alexandra: Backfill plan: add tenant_id(null) to existing rows, then run per-tenant backfill jobs to populate real tenant_id from route metadata. Do in small windows to avoid IO spikes. Use pmap and rate limits.

matt: rough SQL for schema change to demo (will be in migration job):
```sql
ALTER TABLE analytics.events ADD COLUMN tenant_id UUID;
CREATE INDEX ON analytics.events (tenant_id, event_ts DESC);
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW analytics.events_compact AS
  SELECT tenant_id, route_id, event_type, min(event_ts) as first_seen
  FROM analytics.events GROUP BY tenant_id, route_id, event_type;
```

sana: Two caveats: 1) materialized view refresh cost — we should do incremental refresh or move to MV per-tenant. 2) queries that need global aggregates (cross-tenant ops) must be routed to a special batch job or a replica.

kevin: For global aggregates, add a background aggregation job (daily) that writes to analytics.global_metrics. Console will use that for heavy charts and disable real-time for those dashboards during rollout.

irina: Telemetry/metrics: emit migration.phase and rewrite.count. Also emit latency for rewritten queries so we can compare. Create alerts if rewrite-induced latency > 2x baseline.

alexandra: Quotas: tenant-sharding will affect per-tenant quota enforcement. Need to patch quota service to enforce on shard-aware metric keys. I can take that.

matt: Rollout plan: feature-flag the adapter + migration flag. Steps: 1) deploy schema + add column (nullable), 2) enable adapter in staging (opt-in tenants), 3) run backfill for those tenants, 4) enable materialized view for canary tenants, 5) flip adapter to default for all tenants, 6) mark tenant_id not-null and drop old fallback indices.

kevin: Can we do canary by org id range? also need a kill switch — deploy-bot can add a /rollout kill endpoint. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Note: scheduled DDL window approved for 2026-04-02 02:00-05:00 UTC. Will post maintenance notification if migration is run in that window.

matt: Action items: alex to update quota service PR, irina to add telemetry keys + dashboards, alexandra to prepare backfill pipeline, kevin to prototype query-adapter middleware rewrite. I'll open the migration runbook and link to this thread.

sana: tiny UX ask: console should surface a migration banner on affected dashboards so support can explain temporary missing real-time numbers.

kevin: noted. I'll add a banner hook in console rollouts.

matt: thanks all. I’ll create the initial runbook and ping infra for the DDL window.
